meta.title: CVC catalog, coefficients and balance
meta.description:
Three switchable features for a CheapVibeCode route: keeps the model catalog and reasoning levels in the profile patch in sync with /v1/models, shows the price multiplier beside each model in the picker, and puts the remaining balance in a sidebar panel.

The settings page lives in Settings -> CVC and on the bundle page in Plugins -> CVC catalog sync. It has one switch per feature, a field group for its parameters, and Check catalog / Apply catalog buttons that show the diff and then write it; the first run needs the route's API key, which the host resolves by name and never sends to the browser. Everything the plugin reads goes to the CheapVibeCode hosts from the route's own baseURL and installer URLs: no telemetry, no other destination. A switched-off feature registers no route, timer, tool or UI element.
